title: Recording: Goodnight Tonight by Wings | 1979
content:
Replica Studio, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

The recording of Wings’ ‘Goodnight Tonight’ single was completed on 24 January 1979.

The final touch was a new lead vocal part by Paul McCartney. ‘Goodnight Tonight’ was mixed on 29 and 30 January, 1, 5, 8, and 9 February, and 2 March 1979.

Page last updated: 30 January 2026

  • 1969: Get Back/Let It Be sessions: day 15
  • 1967: Paul McCartney and Brian Epstein discuss The Beatles’ third film with Joe Orton
  • 1964: The Beatles live: Olympia Theatre, Paris
